text:
I'm sorry to hear your plant died. Unfortunately, **this isn't covered by the Plant Care Guarantee** — the policy excludes plants repotted into non-Leafy soil within the first 14 days of delivery.

However, if the plant arrived in poor condition (dead, severely wilted, or with exposed roots), you may have a Damaged on Arrival (DOA) claim instead. Did the plant look healthy when it first arrived, or was there visible damage in the box? If DOA applies, you'd need to report it with photos within 48 hours of delivery — what's your delivery date?
